verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a first-party campaign agent that takes a stated goal and plans an entire campaign, so a goal-driven, natural-language way of driving part of the product exists. The evidence does not show general natural-language command of the product (emails, segments, sends, reports), and the MCP server is a separate integration story, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose natural-language command interface, detail on how the agent is prompted and what actions it can execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Start from a goal and let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance.
Create blog posts, social content, and landing pages grounded in your brand voice, audience data, and competitor research.
